---
title: Combined Pack
---

The authored collection and third-party curation have separate entry points.
This repository and site publish only butterlyn's authored skills. A native
skills.sh Pack can combine those with chosen upstream Matt Pocock skills.

**Pack status: pending skill selection and Vercel access/authorization.** No
Pack has been created. The provisional proposal is `tdd` and `codebase-design`,
with the conditional review/setup dependencies described in the
[curation record](https://github.com/butterlyn/engineering-skills/blob/main/CURATION.md).
This proposal is awaiting the owner's choice.

The record has the exact upstream paths, supporting files, setup requirements,
and remaining steps in the native [Pack builder](https://www.skills.sh/packs/create).
It is a maintenance document, not a Pack manifest.

Packs require Vercel sign-in. They are unlisted and anyone with the URL can
view and install them. The builder supports public skill entries, connected
GitHub sources, and file/folder/ZIP uploads; it omits binary files and individual
files over 2 MB. Check required companions before creating a Pack. GitHub CLI
login does not connect Vercel or authorize another service.

The official [Pack documentation](https://www.skills.sh/docs/packs) says new
installs receive current Pack contents and `npx skills update` refreshes changed
installed skills. It does not establish automatic synchronization from an
upstream repository into an existing Pack. Confirm that behavior in the builder
and recheck the Pack after upstream changes, especially for uploaded snapshots.
